# Suspect Insight: Darth Sion threads (read 2026-10-18)
Raw HTML/text: forum-raw/exar-sion/*.html and *.txt. Forum verdicts are OPINION ONLY. SI has few Sion threads (board index + site search found 6); all six read. Sion's only primary source is KOTOR II (game), so most arguments are about how much weight to give the KOTOR Campaign Guide, cut content, and the TSLRCM restoration mod.

## Main arguments
### "Sion is fodder" camp (darthbane77, EmperorCaedus, Primarch, BreakofDawn in jest, CuckedCurry)
- KOTOR Campaign Guide: "Sion embarks on a Jedi-assassination spree, 'dying' many more times, but always ending more enemy lives." => killed repeatedly by ordinary Jedi; "His only saving grace is that his hatred is so strong that he can will himself back. Combatively though, he's absolute garbage" (darthbane77).
- Korriban fight: "Amped on a massively powerful nexus, fighting a Meetra who would have been weakened, and couldn't defeat her" (darthbane77). KingofBlades (t1423): "Meetra beat him multiple times over despite being hindered by the Malachor nexus. They aren't close at all."
- Lonna Vash: HeartoftheForce quotes her log (KOTOR II, Korriban): "I am no fool, but I fell neatly into their trap... Though he was cunning enough to capture me, he seems otherwise to be a volatile brute" => trapped, not beaten in a duel; Primarch: "We don't even see how Lonna Vash died".
- Cut content is non-canon; TSLRCM is a fan mod (darthbane77). The Nihilus "disintegration" is a stage-direction wish ("It would be awesome if..."), "a suggestion. Not a hard fact" (HeartoftheForce).
- t4272: Bandon was Malak's apprentice while Sion already had his immortality. KOTOR Prima guide: "In time, Bandon may even challenge Malak for the mantle of Dark Lord"; Databank: "Some in the Sith hierarchy wondered if Bandon would someday rise to challenge Malak" (Tybalt). Underachiever599: Bandon "canonically above Sion". Counter (Vaelias): potential, not current level, and the SWTOR Codex Triumvirate line ("Three lords stood above all others") is the later framing.
- Avellone (per HellfireUnit, t3941; image not opened): Traya's statements are accurate, which HellfireUnit used to doubt Sion is "even above Traya post Dantooine Enclave."

### "Sion is underrated" camp (AncientPower, Zenwolf, Vaelias, Nute_Chethray, Romeothekotorlover)
- Statements: "ultra-powerful" (Power Beyond Belief), "feared Lightsaber Assassin" and "most rage-filled Sith Lord yet encountered" (Insider #88), "Three lords stood above all others" (SWTOR Codex).
- Kreia's "He cannot be defeated... Flee" on Korriban; the Peragus hand-cut on Kreia.
- Cut-content Nihilus blast: Sion "walks off a Force wave from an enraged Darth Nihilus which buckled bridge supports and disintegrated Sith" (AncientPower). Counter: Romeothekotorlover (t4252) reads the same scene as "Nihilus oneshots Sion and kills him, Sion stands up and leaves".
- "GSW Sion" (pre-prime, killed by Jedi) is decades before KOTOR II Sion (AncientPower). Zenwolf: the CG says he killed more than killed him; immortality means he neglects defense.
- Assassin Force-feeding: claimed for Sion personally (AncientPower); darthbane77: "I don't recall it ever being mentioned that Sion drains the power of those he kills."
- Nute_Chethray: "Not a super-high tier but he's far better than people give him credit for." Ranking guesses (t1423): "Shryne tier" (CuckedCurry), "around Plo Koon... Or Qui-Gon" (Nute), "just below prime Meetra" (BreakofDawn, retracted), "nowhere near Vader level" (BreakofDawn).

### Votes (opinion)
- t1734 Revan vs Sion: Revan, unanimous (~9). "Revan can probably telekinetically rip Sion's body apart" (DarthAnt66).
- t1424 Sion vs Desann: split ~4 Sion (DC77, IG, BreakofDawn, Nute), ~3 Desann (Deronn_Solo, CuckedCurry, winebottle "Without a nexus I don't think Sion has a shot"); MP: depends on whether immortality needs a nexus.
- t3941 Sion vs Azard (Azard must kill him 5 times): Sion (Vaelias, Nute "Azard dies before Sion dies once"); Vaelias's scaling chain (Sion > Muur > Krayt) was mocked.
- t4272 Bandon vs Sion: split; Sion (Vaelias, VictreebelVictr "assuming he has his immortality"), Bandon (Underachiever599, Primarch-ish, Tybalt, lord of hunger "bandon easily").
- t1100 Vader vs Meetra (context): Vader majority ("Vader stomps", HellfireUnit, BreakofDawn, DC77; KingofBlades "good fight"). HellfireUnit: "Surik is only a counter pick for Nihilus, nothing else really."

## Grok's take, per thread
- t1734 Revan vs Sion: **agree, Revan, high.** Revan beats Star Forge Malak; Sion loses repeatedly to the Exile, who is not above Revan in most framing. The only question is whether Revan can make Sion stay down; Revan's Force mastery and mind-game skill (he redeemed/turned people his whole career) mean he can do what the Exile did.
- t4252 "Is Sion that bad?": **middle position.** "Fodder" is wrong: he's a Triumvirate lord, maims Kreia (weakened), traps and kills a Council Master, and leads the purge that nearly ends the Order. "Underrated top-tier" is also wrong: his best offensive feat is cut content, and every in-game loss is to the Exile. His real value is attrition.
- t1423 ranking: closest to Nute's "Plo Koon / Qui-Gon" combat level plus immortality as a modifier. I'd put him tier 7 (below Maul).
- t1424 Desann: lean Sion on a dark-side world (immortality), Desann on neutral ground. Low confidence; Desann is INTRO-less in my notes (GAP).
- t3941 Azard / t4272 Bandon: Sion with immortality; Bandon "may challenge Malak" is potential-hype. Agree with VictreebelVictr's framing.
- Cut content / mod rule: I treat restored cut content (incl. the Sion-Nihilus scene) as low weight and label it, not as zero; the Wookieepedia Nihilus article itself says the scene "is not a final in-game event". Note that Wookieepedia's Nihilus page says Sion attacked and "was rebuffed by a surge of the Force that killed several people around him", while the Sion page and the CV RT script say Nihilus started it - either way Nihilus's blast hits, Sion survives and walks off.
